Class SettingScreen

java.lang.Object
com.view.SettingScreen
public class SettingScreen extends Object
Handles the settings screen for the Masroofy application. Provides options to toggle the privacy lock, change the PIN, reset the current budget cycle, or reset the entire database.

  • Method Details

    • show

      public void show()
      Displays the settings menu and handles user navigation. Loops until the user chooses to go back by entering 'Q'.

    • onToggleLock

      public void onToggleLock()
      Handles the privacy lock toggle option. Prompts the user to enable or disable the privacy lock and delegates to Settingcontroller.togglePrivacyLock(boolean).

    • onChangePIN

      public void onChangePIN()
      Handles the change PIN option. Prompts the user to enter and confirm a new PIN, then delegates to Settingcontroller.changePIN(String). Cancels if the PIN is empty or the confirmation does not match.

    • onResetCycle

      public void onResetCycle()
      Handles the reset current cycle option. Asks for confirmation before permanently deleting all transaction logs and resetting the active budget cycle via Settingcontroller.requestReset().

    • onResetDatabase

      public void onResetDatabase()
      Handles the reset entire database option. Requires the user to type 'RESET' to confirm before permanently erasing all data via Settingcontroller.requestReset().
